content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-live-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-nowpayments-integration-static-site-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-5|Crypto Payment]]-3|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Presets stripe

The inability to use Stripe or other similar platforms forces digital creators to seek alternative solutions for selling their products, such as presets, ebooks, and courses. This is where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes into play, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer. By owning the infrastructure, creators can bypass restrictions and ensure their businesses remain operational without dependence on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling presets without Stripe involves utilizing free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store. This includes hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic tools such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets. Automatic crypto payment verification is facilitated through services like NOWPayments, enabling seamless transactions without the need for conventional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. By providing a base-layer infrastructure solution, these creators can sell their digital products, including presets, without the limitations imposed by these platforms. The focus is on empowering creators with the tools and sovereignty they need to succeed in the digital economy, regardless of their geographical location.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators with the freedom to sell without platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this sovereign commerce infrastructure are carefully chosen to provide a comprehensive solution. From hosting and backend logic to payment processing and order storage, each component plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of the online store. The use of NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, for instance, allows for transactions to be confirmed without the need for traditional payment gateways, thus circumventing platform restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, creators can start by selecting the appropriate components for their needs. This might involve choosing between GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages for hosting, deciding on the backend logic tool, and selecting an order storage solution.
